summary: TR Finance LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a US$1.3bn senior unsecured note offering: US$800m of 5.100% notes due September 15, 2028, and US$500m of 5.750% notes due September 15, 2033. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed, jointly and severally, by Thomson Reuters Corporation, West Publishing, Thomson Reuters Applications and Thomson Reuters (Tax & Accounting). Pricing was 99.989% and 99.756% of par, with underwriting fees of 0.200% and 0.450%. Interest pays semi-annually from March 15, 2027; a Change of Control Triggering Event requires a 101% repurchase offer.
